_source: Verbatim Thai i18n PHRASE consumed by LandPipeline (pototype/land.jsx LandPipeline L62-132), kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so no Thai literal sits in land-pipeline.tsx — same pattern as land-bank-strings.json / boq-strings.json. Every visible string in LandPipeline is an existing DICT key used via t() (land.pipeline.* / land.stage.* / land.tenure.* / land.unit.* / land.bc.root / land.action.export); the ONE exception is the KPI-3 unit 'ล้านบาท', which the land.* dict does not cover — it reuses the existing phrases key (tp) exactly like land-bank-strings.json unitMillionBaht. CONSUME-ONLY, nothing minted here. Confirmed present in i18n-full.json phrases: ล้านบาท (L19914).
